recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future changes are needed to the language extension itself, make them in the FHIR Extension Pack; no current core FHIR source follow-up is indicated for FHIR-25302.
issue_request: FHIR-25302 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to represent languages spoken or services available in languages at a Location, with the final disposition calling for Location-facing standard extension support for communication modes and characteristic support analogous to HealthcareService.communication and HealthcareService.characteristic.
initial_application: Core commit 6e9a2824646e131f72e8f6bc1cfdde9d8e3b6e0e applied the seed by adding StructureDefinition/location-communication and referencing it from implementationguide-Location-core.xml. Related FHIR-20965 commits 0694e9259a7023c4dcaf42820689fe1bcaed0276 and d51b909f2215297921821a275758651be3d5d9fd added Location.characteristic, the characteristic search parameter, and location-characteristic terminology.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps Location active in the core build, and source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml contains Location.characteristic bound to ValueSet/location-characteristic. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed R5 extension definitions from core source. The FHIR Extension Pack now maintains input/definitions/Location/StructureDefinition-location-communication.xml as an active PA extension with Location context and CodeableConcept language binding.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding a core location-communication extension file or Location IG entry would duplicate the current Extension Pack source of truth, while the core characteristic portion remains present and build-scope.

related_jiras.note: Approved and applied the real Location.characteristic element, terminology, and search parameter that covered the characteristic portion referenced during FHIR-25302 application.
Adjacent provider-directory wheelchair/location-characteristic request appeared in the same PA minutes, but was not needed to decide the language-extension seed.
